prompts.boat: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone sprite for a 320x180 pixel-art nautical RPG title screen. Primary request: an EMPTY small wooden fishing boat viewed directly FROM BEHIND its stern, camera slightly elevated, looking forward over its wooden deck toward the bow. It will sit on the right half of the title screen, sailing away toward a bright horizon. Rear transom closest to viewer, bow receding toward top, absolutely NOT a side profile. Warm weathered wood planks, restrained teal painted hull band, rope coil, two small fishing barrels, cabin near bow, modest mast and rigging, clear silhouette and tasteful material shading. No people or characters anywhere. Style: genuine hand-placed low-resolution pixel art matching attached dark-teal rocky tiles reference, cohesive clusters, 12-20 colors, no painting, no smooth gradients or fine noisy detail. Logical sprite size 112x96 pixels, enlarged nearest-neighbor if tool requires larger output; do not create a densely detailed 1024px artwork. Entire boat visible with ample transparent padding. Transparent background, NO ocean, NO wake, NO sky, NO text, NO shadow outside the hull. Input reference: attached image(4).png is style-only, not composition.
prompts.cave: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: compact 16:9 background for full-screen dialogue in a pixel-art nautical RPG, logical canvas EXACTLY 320x180 pixels, optionally enlarged nearest-neighbor for delivery. Match attached rocky dark-teal tile reference for pixel cluster density and palette, tasteful moderate detail, NOT a painterly 1024x1024 illustration. Scene: dark flooded sea cave, irregular craggy rock arch along ceiling, layered deep navy and muted teal rock walls and ledges, distant tunnel fading into near-black at center. A small shallow pool along the bottom with a few muted broken reflections. ONLY three small aqua crystal clusters emit localized dim light, one on the left ledge at about (28,91), one on the right wall at (287,74), one low-right at (247,145). Light softly catches nearby rock facets but the cave remains very dark. Keep central 60 percent visually quiet for character portraits and bottom half subdued for dialogue overlay. NO daylight opening, NO shaft of light, NO torches, NO people, NO text, NO UI, NO algae or plants (animated plants will be separate sprites). Style: handmade low-resolution pixel art, large readable rock planes with restrained chipped texture similar to attached second image, limited 16-24 colors, sharp pixel edges, no gradients, no haze or dense speckles. Whole landscape edge-to-edge, 16:9 landscape.
prompts.sky: Use case: stylized-concept. Use crisp bands and a little stepped atmospheric color, no blur, no rays, no noise. Deliver landscape, not square. Reference image 1 supplies pixel style ONLY, not cave subject or colors.
prompts.cloud: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent CLOUD sprite to reuse in independent parallax layers of a 320x180 nautical pixel-art game title screen. One horizontally elongated cumulus cloud, logical sprite 80x24 pixels, comfortable transparent padding. Handcrafted low-resolution pixel art, readable broad white and cream top lobes, muted pale blue underside, only 4-6 colors, stair-stepped pixel clusters, moderately detailed but simple and solid, NO soft painted brushwork, NO fine texture, NO blur, no glow. Flat front-facing silhouette for a bright blue daytime sky. One cloud only, not a sheet or landscape. Transparent background, NO sky, NO water, NO people, NO text. Can be nearest-neighbor enlarged if required but keep logical pixel art resolution low. Reference image is for pixel clustering style only.
prompts.water: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless ocean WATER texture for independent moving wave planes in a 320x180 pixel-art nautical RPG title screen.
